## Reliance Industries — Consolidated FY 2024–25 vs FY 2023–24

**Revenue from Operations (net of GST):**
- FY 2024–25: ₹9,80,136 crore
- FY 2023–24: ₹9,14,472 crore
- Change: +₹65,664 crore (≈ +7.2%)

**Profit After Tax (before share of associates/JVs):**
- FY 2024–25: ₹80,787 crore
- FY 2023–24: ₹78,633 crore
- Change: +₹2,154 crore (≈ +2.7%)

**Profit for the year (after share of profit of associates and joint ventures):**
- FY 2024–25: ₹81,309 crore
- FY 2023–24: ₹79,020 crore
- Change: +₹2,289 crore (≈ +2.9%)

**Total Comprehensive Income:**
- FY 2024–25: ₹78,873 crore
- FY 2023–24: ₹82,689 crore
- Change: −₹3,816 crore (≈ −4.6%), driven mainly by a swing in Other Comprehensive Income from +₹3,669 crore to −₹2,436 crore [2]

All figures are from the Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss for the year ended 31st March, 2025 [2].

# Apple FY 2026 Quarterly Comparison (each quarter separately)

| Metric | Q1 (Dec 27, 2025) | Q2 (Mar 28, 2026) | Q3 (Jun 27, 2026) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Total net sales | $143,756M [1] | $111,184M [2] | $109,417M [3] |
| Net income | $42,097M [1] | $29,578M [2] | $29,789M [3] |

**Observations**
- Net sales declined from Q1 to Q2 (–$32,572M) and again slightly to Q3 (–$1,767M), reflecting the typical seasonality of Apple's December quarter [1][2][3].
- Net income followed the same pattern: Q1 $42,097M, Q2 $29,578M, then a slight uptick in Q3 to $29,789M [1][2][3].
- Prior-year comparisons show growth in every quarter: Q1 net sales $124,300M → $143,756M [1]; Q2 $95,359M → $111,184M [2]; Q3 $94,036M → $109,417M [3].
